lines.l1: Eight Mr. Olympias. The biggest man to ever step on that stage.
lines.l2: The price? Thirteen surgeries. Eight on his back alone.
lines.l3: And he says he'd do it all again.
lines.l5: Years after retiring... still built like a tank.
lines.l7: Today? Seventy-nine... with a pacemaker in his chest.
lines.l8: So be honest. Was it worth it?
